text_block_list.name: Optimistic Fan
text_block_list.text:
Yesterday's Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe was
sooo close!

text_block_list.name: Skeptical Fan
text_block_list.text:
I don't know about close, but El Condor
Pasa certainly put up a fight.

text_block_list.name: Optimistic Fan
text_block_list.text:
Oh come on, did you see Montjeu in the
homestretch? It's amazing
she could put
up a fight at all!

text_block_list.name: Skeptical Fan
text_block_list.text:
Well, I will admit that of all of Japan's
racers, El Condor Pasa had the
best
chance at winning.

text_block_list.name: Optimistic Fan
text_block_list.text:
That's right, you're always going on about
her, saying she's the best
Japan has to
offer.

text_block_list.name: Skeptical Fan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I guess I already knew this, but...
winning overseas isn't that
easy.

text_block_list.name: Skeptical Fan
text_block_list.text:
Not even the best in Japan can compete
on the world stage.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Not even... the best in Japan...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Best in Japan, here I cooome!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Kyoto Daishoten takes place one
week after the Prix de l'Arc de
Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As such, Special Week is hard at work
making her final preparations.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Spe, are you all right?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: A-ahaha... I messed up my pace.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Would you like to take a break?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm fine. I just need to catch my
breath.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps she's still worn out,
but something
about her smile feels
strained...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
This will be your first 2,400-meter
race in
Kyoto, so try to imagine the
course, but
keep the distance and pace in mind.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
This will be your first 2,400-meter
race in
Kyoto, so try to imagine the
course, but
keep the distance and pace in mind.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Once we've got our groove back with the
Kyoto Daishoten, we'll head into the fall
G1 races and get you one step closer to
the best in
Japan!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Once we've got our groove back with the
Kyoto Daishoten, we'll head into the fall
G1 races and get you one step closer to
the best in
Japan!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: The best in Japan...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Even if I become the best in Japan, what
good—

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Spe?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, never mind me! I think I've caught my
breath, so I'll take another
lap!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
(2,400 meters... Keep that distance and
your pace in mind...)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
(I'll win the Kyoto Daishoten, get my
groove back, and enter the fall
G1 races in
high spirits...)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
(Then I'll be one step closer to being the
best in Japan...)

text_block_list.name: TV Caster
text_block_list.text: Japan's El Condor Pasa was so close... So close! But she was passed at the last minute!

text_block_list.name: TV Caster
text_block_list.text:
We've witnessed the barrier to the
world in
action! El Condor Pasa's
journey ends in a
heart-wrenching second place!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
(Even if I become the best in Japan, does
that really mean anything?)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
(Why even race at all... when the rest of
the world is so much
stronger?)

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
As the fall races fast approach, popular
racers gather to battle it out
here at the
G2 Kyoto Daishoten.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The fan favorite today is Special Week.
After an amazing spring
season, the crowd
has high hopes for her!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The second most popular is Mejiro Bright,
and in third is T.M. Opera
O—A lineup
packed with G1 winners!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
But we can't forget about this racer! In
fourth place in the polls is the
racer who
rose to fame over the summer, Tsurumaru
Tsuyoshi!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
At last... At long last,
I'm here! A G2 race!
The Kyoto Daishoten!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I've only ever been able to watch, no
matter how much I wanted to run. At
times,
running a race like this felt like a
fantasy...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
But finally, this day has come! I'm racing
with G1 racers! I'm racing
with my friends!
At long last!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Oh, Spe!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah, Tsuru.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I heard you're the favorite to win,
Spe! That's so amazing!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
But don't get comfy! I'm in perfect racing
form! Not to mention all the
hard work I
put in preparing for this day!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Huh? Spe, what's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, nothing. You really worked hard,
didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Ehehehe, yeah!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Gotta say, I'm feeling pretty proud of myself. Getting to this point took so, so long...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Oookay! Tsuyoshi's revved up and ready to
race! I'll give all you G1
Umamusumes a
run for your money!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
And don't you dare go easy on me! I
wanna see just what the Derby

Umamusume can do!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: R-right...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Two hundred meters to go! But
something's off with Special Week!
Really,
really off!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huff... wheeze... Hnnngh!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: From the inside comes Mejiro Bright!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: T.M. Opera O has caught up as well!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
But in the lead is Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi!
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
This late bloomer has proven to be the
Golden Generation's secret
weapon! The
winner of the Kyoto Daishoten is
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
In second is Mejiro Bright, followed by
T.M. Opera O!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
As for the fan favorite Special Week, for
the first time ever, she's not
even on the
scoreboard!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Spe...
